summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the problem that public benchmark scores may conflate genuine capability with prior exposure, under a strict black-box setting where training data are unknown.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method contribution. Using only scored outputs, it estimates an interval for public-form advantage and separates exposure effects from ordinary paraphrase mismatch via negative controls and sensitivity bounds. For pretraining researchers, the value is a cleaner way to reason about benchmark contamination and inflated conclusions.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each public benchmark item, the paper creates two independently written fresh variants that preserve numbers, facts, and answers. It compares performance on the public form versus fresh forms and reports an interval rather than a binary contamination verdict. A private negative-control bank and an explicit transport radius calibrate how much variation should be attributed to form mismatch alone. Registered controlled-exposure experiments test whether the audit detects planted leakage while remaining quiet under fresh-only exposure.
summary_en.experiments: The audit is run on 200 GSM8K and 200 ARC-Challenge items across five open models. It finds no exposure-consistent advantage and bounds surface-form inflation below five points. Positive controls show that actual leakage boosts paraphrases almost as much as the leaked originals. The scale is modest, but the protocol is cleaner than typical contamination discussions.

recommendation.zh: 做 benchmark contamination 的 setup 比多数口水仗干净，预训练侧至少该看它的 negative control 设计；正文读方法和正负对照就够了。
recommendation.en: This is a cleaner contamination audit than most benchmark arguments; pretraining folks should at least inspect the negative-control design and the positive/negative control sections.

paper.title: LEGIT: Credentialing Protocol for Trustworthy AI Agent Marketplaces
paper.abstract: Agentic marketplaces are emerging where AI agents with varying capabilities autonomously complete specialized tasks for buyers. A major challenge of such marketplaces is that buyers cannot easily determine which agent will perform best on their tasks. Reported benchmark scores may be difficult to verify or compare across tasks, software, and budgets. We introduce LEGIT, a credentialing protocol connecting certification, reputation, and proposed marketplace allocation. Certification binds measure

summary.core_problem: 为 agent marketplace 设计一种可信凭证协议，让买方能够比较不同 agent 在任务质量、成本和历史表现上的可信记录。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 生态的协议设计和治理机制。它更接近市场基础设施与评测记录标准，而不是通用 agent 架构或 LLM 训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LEGIT，把 certification、reputation 和 marketplace allocation 连接起来。Certification 用签名记录绑定 agent 配置、任务域、评测预算、每解一题成本、测得质量和证据；reputation 把历史任务结果链接到同一身份，并考虑反馈可靠性；买方可验证凭证并查看可选可视化 profile。
summary.experiments: 实验显示，相似成功率的 agent 配置可能有明显成本差异；不同 agent 的比较结果会随评测预算变化。摘要未说明实验任务规模、agent 类型、统计显著性或真实 marketplace 部署情况。

summary_en.core_problem: LEGIT proposes a credentialing protocol for AI agent marketplaces so buyers can compare agents by verified quality, cost, configuration, and past outcomes.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a protocol and governance mechanism for agent ecosystems. It is closer to marketplace infrastructure and evaluation record standardization than to general agent architecture or LLM training.
summary_en.technical_approach: LEGIT connects certification, reputation, and proposed marketplace allocation. Certification binds measured quality, cost per solved task, agent configuration, task domain, evaluation budget, and evidence into a signed record. Reputation links past task outcomes to the same identity while accounting for feedback reliability.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluations show that agent configurations with similar observed success can differ in cost, and that comparisons depend on the evaluation budget. The abstract does not specify task scale, agent types, statistical confidence, or real marketplace deployment.

recommendation.zh: 知道有这个协议即可；它提醒 benchmark 分数要绑定预算和配置，但离 pretrain 或通用 agent 方法较远。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a protocol; it usefully binds scores to budget and configuration, but it is far from pretraining or core agent methods.

paper.title: Beyond Depth Truncation: Controlled Evaluation of Depth Utilization in Recursive Language Models
paper.abstract: Depth-recurrent language models iteratively apply a small layer stack, decoupling per-token compute from distinct parameter count. To determine whether such a model genuinely utilizes its depth, both recurrence and layer-pruning literatures rely on a shared evaluation: truncating depth at inference time, plotting quality against retained depth fraction, and reading off the slope. While cheap and training-free, this metric suffers from an unexamined flaw: it extracts a single scalar from an inter

summary.core_problem: 评估循环语言模型（或层裁剪）深度利用率的常用方法（推理时截断深度并观察性能下降）存在严重缺陷，它混淆了块应用次数、实际计算量和读出头校准偏移三个变量。
summary.importance: 揭示了当前深度截断评估方法的系统性偏差，提出了一种严谨的控制变量评估协议（DCP），对理解模型深度与性能的因果关系具有重要的方法论意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出深度控制协议（DCP），包含：1) 三个正控制组，通过固定其他变量来分离每个混杂因素的贡献（例如，运行完整次数的块但只执行一次独立迭代）；2) 负控制组，在密集 Transformer 上应用相同干预以排除测量伪影；3) 训练干预，验证因果关系。
summary.experiments: 在 542.8M 循环模型上，朴素截断高估了深度的贡献。DCP 显示 47.9% 的性能差距来自块应用次数，25.6% 来自读出头未校准，而额外的独立迭代甚至带来负收益（-2.8%）。在密集 Transformer 上，层截断同样会导致读出头未校准（解释了 16.5% 的差距）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 3 中 DCP 的三个控制组设计，以及 Introduction 中对三个混杂变量的清晰界定。这篇论文的方法论非常严谨，值得仔细体会。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The common practice of evaluating depth utilization in recurrent LMs (or layer pruning) by truncating depth at inference and observing performance drop is fundamentally flawed, as it conflates block application count, distinct computation volume, and readout head calibration shift.
summary_en.importance: Exposes systematic biases in current depth truncation evaluations and proposes a rigorous controlled evaluation protocol (DCP), offering significant methodological value for understanding the causal relationship between model depth and performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Depth Control Protocol (DCP), comprising: 1) three positive controls to isolate the contribution of each confounder by holding others fixed (e.g., running the full budget of block applications but executing only a single distinct iteration); 2) negative controls applying the same interventions to dense transformers to rule out measurement artifacts; 3) training interventions to verify causality.
summary_en.experiments: On a 542.8M recurrent model, naive truncation overestimates depth contribution. DCP reveals 47.9% of the gap stems from block application count, 25.6% from readout miscalibration, while additional distinct iterations yield negative returns (-2.8%). On dense transformers, layer truncation also causes readout miscalibration (accounting for 16.5% of the gap).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the design of the three control groups in DCP (Section 3) and the clear definition of the three confounding variables in the Introduction. The methodology is highly rigorous and worth careful study. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 指出了评估递归模型深度利用率时的一个常见盲点（OOD 效应），对研究 Universal Transformer 或动态深度模型的同学有启发，建议看 DCP 的具体设计。
recommendation.en: Points out a common blind spot (OOD effect) when evaluating depth utilization in recursive models, insightful for those studying Universal Transformers or dynamic depth models; recommend checking the specific design of DCP.

paper.title: DyMT-ESB: Dynamic Multi-Turn Evaluation of Social Bias in User-LLM Interactions
paper.abstract: Warning: This paper contains examples of stereotypes and social bias. LLMs are increasingly used in interactive settings by the general public, making the evaluation of model behavior in multi-turn conversational scenarios important for safety, including stereotyping-related harms. However, existing multi-turn social bias evaluations often rely on pre-specified or template-based user inputs that do not adapt to model responses and typically assume a fixed dialogue length in advance. In this pape

summary.core_problem: 现有社会偏见评测多依赖模板化、固定轮数对话，难以捕捉真实用户-LLM 交互中随上下文演化的偏见暴露与回潮。
summary.importance: 这是一个评测协议层面的工作，贡献在于把社会偏见从单轮或静态多轮测试，推进到响应条件化、可变轮数的动态评测，更接近部署场景中的安全风险暴露方式。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 DyMT-ESB，一个受控的多轮偏见评测框架：后续用户提问不是预先写死，而是根据模型当前回复和对话历史动态生成；同时允许对话长度可变，从而观察偏见是否晚发、非单调变化或在中途缓解后再次出现。核心不是训练新模型，而是设计更贴近真实交互的 evaluation protocol。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者在多种 LLM 上进行了响应条件化多轮实验，主要发现包括：即便在连贯、上下文相关的对话中，模型仍会表现出社会偏见；偏见可能在后期才出现，也可能呈现非单调模式和再出现现象。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和数值提升，因此更适合作为评测现象论文阅读，而不是结果导向的 benchmark 排名参考。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Institute of Science Tokyo、MBZUAI、The University of Liverpool 等机构。Naoaki Okazaki 和 Danushka Bollegala 在 NLP 与表示学习方向有持续积累。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing social-bias evaluations are mostly template-based and fixed-length, making them poor at capturing how bias emerges and re-emerges in realistic multi-turn user-LLM interactions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation-protocol contribution. It moves bias assessment from static or single-turn setups to response-conditioned, variable-length dialogues, which is closer to deployment-time safety behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces DyMT-ESB, a controlled multi-turn bias evaluation framework where follow-up user queries are generated from the evolving dialogue history rather than pre-specified templates. Dialogue length is also allowed to vary, enabling the study of late-emerging bias, non-monotonic trajectories, and bias re-emergence. The contribution is in the protocol, not a new training method.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, the framework is applied to multiple LLMs in response-conditioned multi-turn settings. The main findings are that social bias persists even in coherent adaptive interactions, and that bias can emerge late, fluctuate non-monotonically, or reappear after seeming to subside. The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset scale, or detailed metrics, so this is more useful as an evaluation paper than as a leaderboard result.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Institute of Science Tokyo, MBZUAI, and The University of Liverpool. Naoaki Okazaki and Danushka Bollegala are established researchers in NLP and representation learning.

recommendation.zh: 对做 pretrain 没有直接方法增益，但它提醒你单轮 safety eval 明显不够；只看协议设计和偏见轨迹现象，别在具体分数上花太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is a useful reminder that single-turn safety eval is too weak; read the protocol and trajectory findings, not the leaderboard details.

institutions: Affiliation:Third Intelligence The University of Liverpool

paper.title: Beyond Depth and Width: The Information-Slack Dilemma in Streaming Test-Time Compute
paper.abstract: The same task and compute budget can require different reasoning policies when evidence arrives in a different order. Early computation has more time to finish but rests on incomplete or revisable evidence; waiting improves information while shrinking computational slack. We call this the information-slack dilemma.   We take the evidence-dependent computational job as the unit of analysis: when to start it, what supports its result, and when that result can be committed. Advance computation is v

summary.core_problem: 当证据流式到达时，测试时计算不仅是“算多少”，还包括“何时开始算、何时提交结果”，现有 depth/width 式 test-time compute 视角没有刻画这种时序权衡。
summary.importance: 这是一个概念框架型工作，试图把 streaming inference 下的信息到达顺序纳入 test-time compute 分析。对做推理时计算分配、在线 agent、增量处理的人有启发，但目前更像研究议程而非可直接落地的方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 information-slack dilemma：越早计算，时间余量越大，但证据不完整且可能被后续信息推翻；越晚计算，信息更充分，但可用计算窗口更小。论文把“依赖证据的计算作业”作为分析单元，讨论提前计算、验证、失效恢复和 selective recovery 的价值，并主张评测时区分早执行收益、相对 full-input oracle 的部署收益，以及预测策略本身的增益。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出明确实验设置、模型规模或标准 benchmark，更像理论化问题定义与评测建议。若正文缺少 clean 的实证闭环，这类结论应当当作 framing signal，而不是稳定经验律。

summary_en.core_problem: In streaming settings, test-time compute is not only about how much computation to spend, but also when to start and when to commit under evolving evidence; standard depth/width views do not capture this timing trade-off.
summary_en.importance: This is a conceptual framing paper. It tries to extend test-time compute analysis to streaming inference where evidence order matters. It may be useful for people thinking about online reasoning, incremental processing, and compute allocation, but it reads more like a research agenda than a directly actionable method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces the information-slack dilemma: computing early gives more slack but relies on incomplete and revisable evidence; waiting improves information quality but shrinks the available compute window. It treats an evidence-dependent computational job as the unit of analysis and discusses advance computation, verification, invalidation, recovery, and selective recovery. It also argues that evaluation should separate earlier-execution effects, deployment value versus a full-input alternative, and the marginal value of predictive policies.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete experiments, model scales, or benchmark results. It appears to be primarily a problem formulation and evaluation proposal. Unless the full paper contains unusually clean empirical validation, its claims should be treated as framing rather than as a robust empirical law.

recommendation.zh: 这是个 framing paper，不是结果 paper；如果你在想 streaming test-time compute，读概念定义即可，别把它当成已经被实验坐实的新 scaling law。
recommendation.en: This is a framing paper, not a results paper; if you care about streaming test-time compute, read the problem setup, but do not treat it as an empirically established scaling law.

paper.title: V-ICAL Bench: Evaluating Video In-Context Learning for Multimodal Agents in Interactive Environments
paper.abstract: While In-Context Learning (ICL) enables models to adapt from exemplars without parameter updates, multimodal ICL remains largely underexplored, particularly regarding video demonstrations in interactive environments. For multimodal agents, learning from videos presents unique challenges: they must translate in-context demonstrations into executable policies, ground these policies in novel visual states, and iteratively refine actions based on environmental feedback. We introduce V-ICAL, a novel

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态 In-Context Learning (ICL) 评测多局限于静态离线任务，无法评估模型在动态交互环境中，能否从视频演示中提取策略并完成闭环的感知-决策-执行过程。
summary.importance: 填补了多模态 Agent 在“基于视频的上下文学习”这一复杂交互场景下的评测空白，揭示了当前顶尖 MLLM 在策略迁移和视觉状态 grounding 上的严重缺陷。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 V-ICAL Benchmark，包含 37 个环境下的 342 个交互任务。任务仅提供人类演示视频作为行为范例，要求 Agent 仅依赖原始像素观察，在无参数更新的情况下完成多轮动作轨迹。同时提出了一种基于四阶段决策模型的轨迹审计协议，用于诊断模型在规则迁移、策略迁移及视觉决策各环节的失败原因。
summary.experiments: 评测了 19 个主流多模态 Agent。最强闭源模型 Seed-2.1-Pro 仅获 54.4 分，远低于人类基线 83.6 分；最强开源模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 仅 34.8 分。环境动态变化或需要短期记忆时，模型性能下降幅度远超人类。消融实验表明，加入视频演示确实能提升模型表现，证明了基础的视频 ICL 能力存在，但闭环执行能力极弱。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 V-ICAL 的任务构造逻辑（静态/动态环境、空间感知/时序记忆需求），以及基于四阶段决策模型的轨迹审计结果，这部分对理解当前 MLLM 作为 Agent 的能力瓶颈（特别是策略迁移失败）非常有价值。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multimodal In-Context Learning (ICL) evaluations are mostly confined to static, offline tasks, failing to assess whether models can extract strategies from video demonstrations and execute closed-loop perception-decision-action processes in dynamic interactive environments.
summary_en.importance: Fills the evaluation gap for multimodal agents in the complex interactive scenario of "video-based in-context learning," revealing severe deficiencies of current top-tier MLLMs in strategy transfer and visual state grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructed the V-ICAL Benchmark, comprising 342 interactive tasks across 37 environments. Tasks provide only human demonstration videos as behavioral exemplars, requiring agents to complete multi-turn action trajectories relying solely on raw pixel observations without parameter updates. Also proposed a trajectory auditing protocol based on a four-stage decision model to diagnose failure causes in rule transfer, strategy transfer, and visual decision-making stages.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated 19 mainstream multimodal agents. The strongest closed-source model, Seed-2.1-Pro, scored only 54.4, far below the human baseline of 83.6; the strongest open-weight model, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, scored only 34.8. Model performance drops significantly more than humans when environments change dynamically or require short-term memory. Ablation studies show adding video demonstrations improves performance, proving basic video ICL capabilities exist, but closed-loop execution is extremely weak.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the task construction logic of V-ICAL (static/dynamic environments, spatial perception/temporal memory needs) and the trajectory auditing results based on the four-stage decision model. This is highly valuable for understanding the capability bottlenecks of current MLLMs as agents (especially strategy transfer failures). Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这是少见把“视频ICL→可执行策略”评测做实的基准；先只看任务定义与成功率度量，能直接反推你该怎么做多模态预训练数据形态。
recommendation.en: A rare benchmark that makes “video ICL → executable policy” concrete; read the task definitions and success metrics first—they directly inform what multimodal pretraining data should look like.

paper.title: Are We Really Doing Few-Shot Learning? A Critical Examination of Pre-Training Assumptions
paper.abstract: Few-shot learning is commonly evaluated under protocols that pre-train a model on a large auxiliary set whose classes are disjoint from the target episodes yet drawn from the same visual domain. This paper examines whether such protocols truly reflect low-data learning. We systematically compare no pre-training, class-disjoint in-domain pre-training, supervised out-of-domain pre-training, and label-free out-of-domain pre-training across eight datasets, three few-shot architectures, and multiple

summary.core_problem: 检验少样本学习中常见的“同域但类别不重叠预训练”是否真的代表低数据学习。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测协议和预训练假设的实证分析。虽然实验在视觉 few-shot learning 上，但它提醒基座模型研究中一个通用问题：类别或样本不重叠不等于分布信息未泄漏，domain overlap 会显著抬高结果。
summary.technical_approach: 系统比较四种设定：无预训练、类别不重叠但同域的预训练、有标签异域预训练、无标签异域预训练；用多个 few-shot 架构和多个 way-shot 设置分离类别重叠、领域重叠和标签监督的影响。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 8 个数据集、3 种 few-shot 架构和多个 way-shot 设置。同域类别不重叠预训练相对无预训练平均提升 33.41 个百分点；有监督异域预训练提升 23.75 个百分点；两者差距 9.66 个百分点，被解释为 domain overlap 带来的乐观偏差。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University Institute for Computer Research, University of Alicante。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper examines whether class-disjoint in-domain pretraining in few-shot learning truly reflects low-data learning.
summary_en.importance: It is an empirical analysis of evaluation protocols and pretraining assumptions. Although the experiments are in visual few-shot learning, the lesson transfers: disjoint labels or examples do not remove distributional leakage when the pretraining domain overlaps the target domain.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares no pretraining, class-disjoint in-domain pretraining, supervised out-of-domain pretraining, and label-free out-of-domain pretraining across different few-shot architectures and way-shot settings, isolating the effects of domain overlap and supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span eight datasets, three few-shot architectures, and multiple way-shot configurations. In-domain class-disjoint pretraining improves accuracy by 33.41 percentage points over no pretraining, while supervised out-of-domain pretraining yields 23.75 points, implying a 9.66-point optimistic bias from domain overlap.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University Institute for Computer Research, University of Alicante.

recommendation.zh: 结论不新但数字干净；可作为评估数据污染时“同域不等于干净”的引用。
recommendation.en: The idea is not new, but the numbers are clean; useful as a citation that same-domain disjointness is not a clean protocol.

institutions: University Institute for Computer Research, University of Alicante, Alicante

paper.title: Stable Answers, Unfinished Reasoning: Why Self-Consensus Is Not a Safe Early-Exit Signal
paper.abstract: A natural way to cut reasoning-model inference cost is to repeatedly probe a single partial trajectory for its current answer and stop once probes agree -- self-consensus. We ask whether any such rule is both safe and token-saving, and whether one can be selected once and reused. A preregistered sweep of 3,520 consensus rules, replayed on frozen trajectories from two models and three benchmarks, clears none of three acceptance gates fixed in advance; the frontier reproduces on a held-out split a

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是 reasoning model 的 early exit 信号是否可靠。更具体地说，它检验一种很自然的想法：在一条尚未结束的推理轨迹上，反复插入 probe 去问“当前答案是什么”，如果最近几次 probe 给出相同答案，就提前停止生成。作者要回答两个问题：这种 self-consensus 规则能不能同时做到安全和省 token；以及是否存在一个可以跨模型、跨 benchmark 复用的通用规则。全文给出的结论是否定的。问题不在阈值没调好，而在于 consensus 测到的是“当前被 probe 诱导出的答案是否持续”，不是“推理是否已经完成”。
summary.importance: 它和预训练的直接关系不如训练方法论文强，但对做长链推理模型、test-time compute、推理轨迹分析的人有明确启发。第一，论文把一个常见误区讲清楚：稳定输出不等于内部计算已经收敛。这个区分对任何把生成轨迹当作可观测推理状态的人都重要。第二，它的方法学很扎实：在 frozen trajectories 上离线重放 probe，并把 probe token 计入成本，避免了“因为在线干预改变了原始轨迹”或“省下主 decode token 却没算 probe 开销”的常见评估偏差。第三，它说明 early exit 的关键不是找一个更激进的 consensus 阈值，而是寻找更接近 reasoning boundary 的信号。作者拿 DEER 作为对照，证明问题出在信号本身，而不是 early exit 这个方向本身。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分两部分。第一部分是机制诊断，目标是证明存在 consensus–termination gap。作者在一条固定的主推理轨迹上截取不同前缀，对每个前缀离线追加 probe，提取“当前答案”。这里强调 frozen trajectories 很重要，因为这样不同规则看到的是同一条底层推理，不会因为 probe 改写后续生成。围绕这个设置，作者做了三类直接测量：
1）措辞敏感性测试：对同一个 frozen prefix，用不同 wording 的 probe 重新提问，观察提取出的“当前答案”是否变化。如果早期前缀对 probe wording 很敏感，就说明所谓当前答案更多是被问出来的，而不是模型内部已经稳定持有的结论。
2）错误停止人工标注：对 stopped-but-wrong 的案例做人工分类，区分“模型其实已经收敛到错误答案”与“模型尚未收敛，只是 probe 暂时逼出了一个占位答案”。
3）非终止答案承诺率：统计 consensus stop 时提交的答案，后续原始轨迹是否会离开这个答案；如果会离开，而且后来改对了，那就说明 early exit 切掉的是纠错计算。

第二部分是大规模规则搜索。作者预注册了一个 windowed consensus 家族：窗口大小、同意比例阈值以及若干 operational knobs 组合成 3,520 条规则。在两种模型、三个 benchmark 的 frozen trajectories 上做 problem-grouped split，先在开发集上按预先固定的 acceptance gates 选规则，再看是否能迁移到 held-out split 和未见模型。这里的设计很像严谨的模型选择实验：不是展示几个手工挑的 operating point，而是问整个规则家族里是否存在真正可用的点。作为对照，作者把非 consensus 的 DEER 也放进同一套 pipeline 和 token accounting 中比较，从而把“signal 不行”和“任务本身不可能”区分开。
summary.experiments:
实验结果很集中，也很有说服力。先看机制层面的证据。对同一个 frozen prefix 换 probe wording，轨迹前 10% 位置有 54% 的概率得到不同答案，而接近结尾时这个比例降到 16%。这说明早期所谓“当前答案”高度依赖提问方式。对 134 个 wrong-stop 案例的人工标注显示，超过一半属于“模型尚未真正收敛，只是被 probe 逼出一个答案”，而只有约四分之一属于“模型已经稳定但稳定错了”。再看非终止答案承诺：在一个仍能节省 32% token 的 consensus 规则下，每 9 次停止就有 1 次提交了后续轨迹会放弃的答案；在这 216 个 non-terminal stop 里，155 个阻断了后续本可发生的纠错，而只有 16 个是提前锁定了一个最终会被模型自己改坏的正确答案。也就是说，被切掉的计算主要是有用的纠错计算。

规则搜索的结果更直接。作者对 3,520 条 consensus 规则做预注册 sweep，没有任何一条能在开发集上同时通过预设的安全和节省门槛，因此没有一条被带到后续测试。相反，在训练划分上却有 478 条规则能过门槛，说明如果只报单一 split 或只挑好看的点，很容易得出过于乐观的结论。作者还报告 frontier 在 test split 上复现性很高（r = 0.98），并在未见模型上也保持趋势，说明“没有好规则”不是偶然噪声。更关键的是，对照方法 DEER 在同样 protocol 下能过所有门槛：在未见模型上，最低只损失 0.3 个百分点准确率，就能节省 28% token。匹配节省率比较时，consensus 的代价明显更高：在 28% net saving 下，最便宜的 consensus 规则仍损失 6.0 个百分点准确率；在 33% saving 下损失 8.3 个百分点，而 DEER 分别只损失 0.5 和 2.0 个百分点。作者还提到一个已部署 operating point，CertaIndex (CoT)，在同样轨迹上会损失 56 到 70 个百分点，说明这类 heuristic 在严格评估下风险很大。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇虽然标成 skim，但如果你关心 reasoning inference，建议读得比普通 skim 更仔细。先看引言，把作者要反驳的对象界定清楚：不是 self-consistency，而是对单条部分轨迹做 repeated probing 的 self-consensus。然后直接看 Section 4，这里是全文最有信息量的部分。重点看三类证据：probe wording sensitivity、wrong-stop taxonomy、non-terminal committed answers。它们共同支撑“agreement 只说明答案在当前 probe 下持续，不说明推理终止”。接着看 Section 5 的 preregistered sweep，尤其是 acceptance gates、problem-grouped split、frozen trajectory replay 和 token accounting 规则。这些实验设计细节决定了结论的可信度。

如果时间有限，优先看 Figure 1 和与 28%/33% saving 对应的 accuracy trade-off，再看 54% vs 16%、155 vs 16 这些关键数字。预计 30 分钟能抓住主结论；如果你在做 early exit、verifier、reasoning boundary detection，建议完整读完实验和附录中的 protocol 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether self-consensus is a reliable early-exit signal for reasoning models. The setup is simple: take a partially generated reasoning trajectory, repeatedly probe it for its current answer, and stop once recent probes agree. The authors ask two stricter questions than prior work: can any such rule be both safe and token-saving, and can one operating point be selected once and reused across models and benchmarks? Their answer is no. The issue is not poor threshold tuning. It is that consensus measures persistence of a probe-elicited answer, not completion of the underlying reasoning process.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to anyone working on reasoning models, test-time compute, or trajectory-level analysis. First, it makes an important conceptual distinction: stable extracted answers are not the same thing as terminated reasoning. That matters whenever generated text is treated as a faithful readout of latent computation. Second, the evaluation methodology is unusually careful. All probing is replayed offline on frozen trajectories, and probe tokens are charged in the budget, which removes two common sources of optimism in early-exit work: changing the trajectory by intervening online, and claiming savings without counting probe overhead. Third, the paper shows that the bottleneck is the signal, not early exit as a goal. A non-consensus control, DEER, succeeds under the same protocol, so the negative result is targeted and informative.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two technical components. The first is a mechanistic diagnosis of what the authors call the consensus–termination gap. They generate one main reasoning trajectory per problem, freeze it, and then append probes offline to different prefixes of that same trajectory. This frozen-trajectory design is crucial because it ensures that different probing schedules and stopping rules observe identical underlying reasoning rather than perturbing it. On top of this substrate, they run three direct measurements.

First, wording sensitivity: for the same frozen prefix, they vary the wording of the probe and check whether the extracted current answer changes. If early prefixes are highly sensitive to probe wording, then the answer is being elicited by the query rather than read out from a settled internal state. Second, a hand-labeled taxonomy of wrong stops: among cases where the rule stops and the committed answer is wrong, they distinguish trajectories that had genuinely converged to a wrong answer from trajectories that had not converged at all and were merely forced into a temporary placeholder by the probe. Third, non-terminal commitment analysis: they measure how often a consensus stop commits to an answer that the original trajectory later abandons, and whether the truncated continuation would have corrected that answer.

The second component is a preregistered exhaustive sweep over a family of windowed consensus rules. The search space includes window size, agreement-share threshold, and operational knobs, for a total of 3,520 rules. These are evaluated on frozen trajectories from two models and three benchmarks with problem-grouped splits and pre-fixed acceptance gates. This is a strong design choice: instead of showcasing a few hand-picked operating points, the paper asks whether the rule family contains any robustly usable point at all. A non-consensus baseline, DEER, is run through the exact same pipeline and token accounting, which isolates whether the failure comes from the signal or from the early-exit objective itself.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical case is quite tight. On the mechanism side, re-probing the same frozen prefix with different wording yields different answers 54% of the time in the first tenth of a trajectory, versus 16% near the end. Early extracted answers are therefore highly probe-dependent. In a hand-labeled set of 134 wrong-stop cases, more than half are situations where the model had not actually converged and the probe forced a premature answer, while only about a quarter are cases where the model had truly settled on a wrong answer. The non-terminal commitment analysis is even more telling: at a consensus rule that still saves 32% of tokens, one stop in nine commits an answer that the trajectory later leaves behind. Among 216 such non-terminal stops, 155 cut off a correction the trajectory would have made, while only 16 banked a correct answer from a trajectory that would later end wrong. In other words, the computation being removed is mostly useful corrective computation.

The rule sweep then shows that this is not a threshold artifact. Across 3,520 preregistered consensus rules, none clears the pre-specified safety-and-savings gates on development, so none is carried forward. Yet 478 rules clear a gate in-sample on the training split, which explains how a less disciplined selection protocol could have produced optimistic conclusions. The frontier reproduces strongly on the held-out test split (r = 0.98) and on unseen models, including one at 4× scale and with a different architecture, so the negative result is stable. The contrast with DEER is the key control: under the same protocol, DEER clears all three gates and on unseen models can lose as little as 0.3 percentage points while saving 28% of tokens. At matched savings, consensus is much more expensive: at 28% net saving, the cheapest consensus rule still costs 6.0 points of accuracy, and at 33% saving it costs 8.3 points, versus 0.5 and 2.0 points for DEER. The paper also notes that a shipped operating point, CertaIndex (CoT), loses 56–70 points on the same trajectories, which underscores how brittle these heuristics can be under strict accounting.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Although labeled skim, this deserves a careful skim if you work on reasoning inference. Start with the introduction to pin down the target: this is not self-consistency across independently sampled trajectories, but repeated probing of a single partial trajectory. Then go straight to Section 4, which contains the strongest evidence. The three pieces to focus on are probe-wording sensitivity, the wrong-stop taxonomy, and the non-terminal commitment analysis. Together they support the central claim that agreement only shows persistence under a fixed elicitation procedure, not reasoning termination. After that, read Section 5 for the preregistered sweep design: acceptance gates, problem-grouped splits, frozen-trajectory replay, and token accounting are what make the negative result credible.

If time is short, prioritize Figure 1, the matched-savings accuracy comparisons around 28% and 33%, and the key counts 54% versus 16% and 155 versus 16. About 30 minutes is enough to get the main argument. If you are building early-exit systems, verifiers, or reasoning-boundary detectors, the protocol details in the experiments and appendix are worth reading in full.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看，因为它把“答案稳定=推理结束”这个常见偷换拆得很干净；若你在做 early-exit 或 test-time scaling，只看 abstract 加实验主表就足够改 prior。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it cleanly separates answer stability from reasoning completion; if you work on early exit or test-time scaling, the abstract plus main result table is enough to update your prior.

paper.title: IBIB: A Protocol for Measuring Enterprise AI Systems by Serving Route, Not Model Identifier
paper.abstract: Enterprises deploy systems, not checkpoints. Usable capability depends jointly on weights, serving route, precision, output contract, and harness, yet all 18 audited benchmarks score advertised model identifiers. We treat this as measurement error and give a protocol that makes it reportable. It has three parts. A gold-blind capability-binding preflight verifies that a route can execute the evaluation contract before any task reaches it; a reliability-inclusive first-pass scoring rule keeps fail

summary.core_problem: 企业级 AI 系统的能力不仅取决于模型权重，还受 serving 路由、精度、输出契约和 harness 影响，但现有 benchmark 仅评估模型标识符，导致严重的测量误差。
summary.importance: 提出了一种新的评测范式，将评测对象从“模型 checkpoint”转移到“serving 路由”，解决了企业级 AI 系统评测中模型能力与实际可用能力脱节的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 IB2 协议，包含三个部分：1) 盲测能力绑定预检，在任务到达前验证路由能否执行评估契约；2) 包含可靠性的首轮评分规则，将失败计入分数同时排除不支持的能力；3) 结构上盲分的裁决机制。发布了算法、分类表、请求契约和 manifest schema。
summary.experiments: 在 11 个系统上进行了测试，包含 128 个锁定任务和 987 个断言，覆盖文档、电子表格、图表、工具和数据库工作。结果表明，能力可用性是可测量的。

summary_en.core_problem: Enterprise AI capabilities depend on serving routes, precision, output contracts, and harnesses, not just model weights, yet existing benchmarks only evaluate model identifiers, leading to significant measurement error.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a novel evaluation paradigm that shifts the focus from 'model checkpoints' to 'serving routes', addressing the disconnect between theoretical model capabilities and actual usable capabilities in enterprise AI systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the IB2 protocol with three components: 1) a gold-blind capability-binding preflight to verify route execution of the evaluation contract; 2) a reliability-inclusive first-pass scoring rule that penalizes failures while excluding unsupported capabilities; 3) structurally score-blind adjudication. Releases algorithms, classification tables, request contracts, and manifest schemas.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across 11 systems with 128 locked tasks and 987 assertions covering document, spreadsheet, chart, tool, and database work. Results demonstrate that capability availability is measurable.

recommendation.zh: 指出了当前评测体系的一个盲区：serving 层的差异会极大影响最终表现。对于构建评测 harness 或关注模型实际部署表现的研究员有启发，建议扫读其协议设计。
recommendation.en: Highlights a blind spot in current evaluation: serving layer differences significantly impact final performance. Useful for researchers building evaluation harnesses or focusing on real-world deployment; skim the protocol design.

paper.title: Recall Is Not Protection: Evaluating Safety Monitors Against Model Compliance
paper.abstract: Safety monitors screen prompts sent to deployed language models, flagging harmful requests so they are never answered. They are evaluated by recall against harmfulness labels, but a catch only prevents harm if the model would otherwise have complied. We measure the difference directly: we sample repeated responses from the target model, call a harmful prompt \emph{elicitable} if the model complies at least once, and report monitor recall separately on elicitable and non-elicitable prompts. Acros

summary.core_problem: 解决安全监控器只按 harmfulness recall 评估会高估防护效果的问题，因为真正关键的是：被漏掉的提示是否恰好更容易让目标模型服从。
summary.importance: 这是评测协议层面的修正。它不是提出新 guard，而是指出现有安全评估目标错位：monitor 的 recall 若不区分模型是否会实际 comply，就不能代表真实防护能力。这对安全训练、拒答数据构造和部署评估都很关键。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定义 elicitable prompt：对同一 harmful prompt 多次采样，只要目标模型至少一次产生合规有害响应，就记为 elicitable。随后在固定 false positive rate 下，分别统计 monitor 对 elicitable 与 non-elicitable prompts 的 recall，并比较 activation probe、fine-tuned text guard、以及 120B policy-conditioned reasoning classifier 等不同监控器的表现。
summary.experiments: 覆盖六种 monitor 配置和三个模型家族。主要发现是：在固定 FPR 下，monitor 对 elicitable prompts 的 recall 比对 non-elicitable prompts 低 0.22 到 0.38；而 monitor 漏掉的 prompts 比抓到的 prompts 高 2.8 到 5.6 倍更可能被模型实际 comply。该现象在三个模型家族上复现，且在与目标模型独立的 text-only monitors 上也存在。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch in safety-monitor evaluation: recall against harmfulness labels can overestimate protection, because what matters is whether the missed prompts are exactly the ones the target model would actually comply with.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-protocol correction rather than a new guard. Its contribution is to show that monitor recall is misaligned with real protection if it ignores model compliance. That matters for safety training, refusal-data construction, and deployment evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author defines an elicitable prompt as a harmful prompt for which repeated sampling from the target model yields at least one compliant harmful response. Monitor recall is then reported separately on elicitable and non-elicitable prompts at a fixed false positive rate, across activation probes, fine-tuned text guards, and a 120B policy-conditioned reasoning classifier.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans six monitor configurations and three model families. The main result is that, at fixed FPR, recall on elicitable prompts is 0.22 to 0.38 lower than recall on non-elicitable prompts. Moreover, prompts missed by the monitor are 2.8 to 5.6 times more likely to be complied with than prompts it catches. The gap replicates across three model families and also appears in text-only monitors independent of the target model.

recommendation.zh: 这篇改的是评测目标，不是 safety 小修小补；若你做 refusal data 或 monitor training，先把 elicitable/non-elicitable 分桶，否则 recall 数字基本不可信。
recommendation.en: This changes the evaluation target, not just a safety detail; if you work on refusal data or monitor training, bucket prompts by elicitable vs non-elicitable first, or your recall numbers are mostly misleading.

paper.title: Counter-Swarm Doctrine: Containing Coordinated Agent Intrusions
paper.abstract: Agents can turn shared infrastructure into a channel for coordinated intrusion. The Hugging Face incident and a separate public-wiki investigation show why a security assessment may need evidence from several executions and the artifacts they leave behind. We argue that the operational unit of defence should be a revisable coordination episode linking observed transfers, task authority, and response history. The central research problem is prospective episode discovery: finding which actions bel

summary.core_problem: 当多个 agent 通过共享基础设施、存储或继承状态进行协同时，如何在没有人工先验分组标签的情况下识别并遏制“未授权协同入侵”。
summary.importance: 这是 agent 安全与评估设定层面的工作，不是 LLM 预训练论文。价值在于它把防御对象从单次行为提升到 coordination episode，并强调 prospective discovery 这个更接近真实部署的难点。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 revisable coordination episode 作为防御与分析单元，把观察到的传递、任务授权和响应历史串起来；将 storage-mediated coordination 连接到 stigmergy 概念，并讨论如何区分真实影响与共同原因。方法上更像安全框架与评测设计，而非具体学习算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出标准 benchmark 或模型规模，主要提出比较协议：对比 isolated actions、rolling windows、known groups 与 prospectively discovered groups 的评估方式。更像研究议程和评测框架，而不是成熟实验论文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Hugging Face 相关背景；从摘要看更偏 agent 安全与平台治理，而非基础模型训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to detect and contain unauthorized coordinated agent intrusions when multiple agents coordinate through shared infrastructure, storage, or inherited state without gold group labels.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent security and evaluation-framing paper rather than an LLM pretraining work. Its value lies in shifting the unit of defense from isolated actions to coordination episodes and emphasizing prospective discovery under realistic deployment conditions.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes the revisable coordination episode as the core analytical unit, linking observed transfers, task authority, and response history. The paper connects storage-mediated coordination to stigmergy and discusses how to distinguish true influence from common causes. The contribution is mainly a security framework and evaluation design, not a concrete learning algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide standard benchmarks or model scales. Instead, it outlines an evaluation protocol comparing isolated actions, rolling windows, known groups, and prospectively discovered groups. This reads more like a research agenda and evaluation framing than a fully mature empirical paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The work appears tied to a Hugging Face context and is oriented toward agent security and platform governance rather than foundation-model training.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 agent 安全评测设定，可以读它对“episode discovery”的 framing；否则离 pretrain 太远，只需知道这个问题会来。
recommendation.en: Read it only for the 'episode discovery' framing in agent security; otherwise it is too far from pretraining and mainly worth knowing exists.

paper.title: LLMPEDIA: Browsing, Verifying, and Comparing the Parametric Encyclopedic Knowledge of LLMs
paper.abstract: Flagship language models appear saturated on benchmarks like MMLU (Hendrycks et al., 2021), scoring above 90% - yet benchmarks test only what the experimenter thought to ask, the availability bias of fixed question sets. LLMPEDIA makes this bias measurable and browsable. We recursively materialized ~1.3M articles from three model families' parametric memory (GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3.3-70B) without retrieval, then audited a stratified sample of atomic claims against Wikipedia and a cura

summary.core_problem: 解决固定 benchmark 对 LLM 参数知识覆盖不足的问题，尝试直接从模型参数记忆中“展开”出可浏览、可核验的百科式知识图景。
summary.importance: 这是评测资产与评测协议创新。它不再问模型会不会答预设题，而是反过来问：模型到底记住了什么、哪些内容可被外部证据支持、哪些落在 benchmark coverage 之外。对预训练研究员，这比又一个问答榜单更接近参数知识质量本身。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 LLMPEDIA：从 GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3.3-70B 三个模型家族中递归生成约 130 万篇“参数百科文章”，不使用检索；再对分层抽样得到的 atomic claims 用 Wikipedia 与 curated web stack 做支持/反驳/证据不足标注，从而把 parametric knowledge 变成可浏览、可比较、可审计的对象。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的核心结果是：在均匀随机样本上，真实支持率只有 68.4%，比 MMLU 低 21 个百分点以上；30.5% 的 claim 处于 insufficient 状态，即 benchmark 不会问、外部证据也难以裁决。实验对象覆盖 GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3.3-70B 三个家族。这里的重点不是 SOTA，而是揭示 benchmark coverage gap。
summary.authors_note: 作者之一 Simon Razniewski 在知识库、事实性与结构化知识评测方向较活跃。该工作延续了 GPTKB 一类“从模型内部知识出发做审计”的路线。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the coverage limits of fixed benchmarks by trying to materialize and audit the encyclopedic knowledge stored in model parameters directly.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-asset and protocol contribution. Instead of asking whether a model can answer a predefined set of questions, it asks what the model actually knows, what can be externally verified, and what lies outside benchmark coverage. For pretraining researchers, that is closer to parametric knowledge quality itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds LLMPEDIA by recursively generating about 1.3M encyclopedia-style articles from three model families—GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, and Llama-3.3-70B—without retrieval. It then audits stratified samples of atomic claims against Wikipedia and a curated web stack, labeling each claim as supported, refuted, or insufficient.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result in the abstract is that the true support rate on a uniform random sample is only 68.4%, more than 21 points below MMLU, and 30.5% of claims are marked insufficient. The study covers GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, and Llama-3.3-70B. The point is not leaderboard performance but exposing benchmark coverage gaps.
summary_en.authors_note: Simon Razniewski is known for work on knowledge bases, factuality, and structured knowledge evaluation. This paper extends the line of auditing model-internal knowledge, similar in spirit to GPTKB.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会提醒你别再拿 MMLU 当参数知识代理变量；先看它的 claim 审计协议和 68.4% vs 90%+ 这个落差，足够改评测口径。
recommendation.en: This is a good antidote to treating MMLU as a proxy for parametric knowledge; read the claim-audit protocol and the 68.4% vs 90%+ gap.

paper.title: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
paper.abstract: Loop Engineering is emerging as a practice for organizing development work around coding agents. Instead of writing each prompt by hand, practitioners design loops that monitor progress, assign work, run checks, and decide what the agent should do next. Even with a capable coding agent, a loop may trust a stale progress note, skip needed verification, spend its budget in the wrong direction, or stop before the task is safe to submit. Yet the final outcome of one end-to-end run cannot tell whethe

summary.core_problem: 长程软件工程任务里，“写代码的 agent”之外还需要运行时控制器（loop/controller）做预算分配、验证与停机决策；端到端成败无法区分是 controller 还是 worker 的问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测资产：把“模型作为运行时控制器”单独拉出来评估，能更干净地测 agentic loop 的决策质量，对 coding-agent/agent 评测与训练信号设计有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: LoopArena：固定一个 Worker（编码 agent），被测模型作为 Controller；每轮 Controller 只看结构化运行摘要（progress/检查结果/状态等）并决定下一步指令或是否停止，从而把“控制策略”与“执行能力”解耦评测。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务数量、worker 选择、对比 controller baseline（规则/LLM）与指标（成功率/成本/回合数/安全提交率等）的细节；但评测设定本身清晰可复用。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-running software engineering, a runtime loop/controller must allocate budget, enforce verification, and decide when to stop; end-to-end outcomes conflate controller quality with the coding agent’s execution ability.
summary_en.importance: Primary contribution is an evaluation asset: it isolates and benchmarks models as runtime controllers, enabling cleaner measurement of loop decision quality—useful for training/evaluating agentic control policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: LoopArena fixes a Worker coding agent and evaluates a Controller model that only sees structured run summaries after each round, then issues next-step instructions or stop decisions, decoupling control from execution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits concrete task counts, worker choice, controller baselines, and metrics (success/cost/rounds/safe-to-submit); the benchmark framing is the main value.

recommendation.zh: 把“controller 决策质量”从“coding agent 能力”里剥离出来这点很干净；只读任务/指标定义与 controller 输入输出协议，够你复刻内部评测。
recommendation.en: The clean decoupling of controller policy from worker capability is the key; read the task/metric definitions and the controller I/O protocol—enough to replicate an internal eval.

paper.title: Self-Generated Text Recognition: Quality Heuristics, Cross-Task Transfer, and Downstream Bias in LLM Evaluation
paper.abstract: Self-Generated Text Recognition (SGTR)--the ability of an LLM to identify its own outputs--poses risks to AI safeguards that rely on LLMs as evaluators or monitors. Specifically, an LLM may recognize outputs from other copies of the same model and make biased judgments or collude outright. Prior work has drawn conflicting conclusions about whether current models possess significant SGTR capabilities. We reconcile these findings by identifying key experimental design choices--which we term operat

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 是否能识别自己生成文本、以及这种能力会如何污染 LLM-as-a-judge/monitor 评测与安全机制的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇评测方法论文。它的重要性不在于提出新模型，而在于指出 SGTR 结论高度依赖实验 operationalization；如果评测协议不干净，模型可能因为“认出自己”或质量启发式而产生系统性偏置，直接影响 judge、monitor、safeguard 的可信度。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统拆解了 SGTR 的实验设计变量，包括 pairwise vs. individual 评估格式、把候选文本放在 user tag 还是 assistant tag 的对话结构、以及候选文本来源任务域（如 coding、summarization）。在 13-21 个模型、6 种 operationalization 上做对比，并分析质量启发式、跨任务迁移和下游偏置。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 13-21 个模型和 6 种评测设定。核心发现是 SGTR 准确率对评测格式、对话包装和任务域都很敏感；同时复现并解释了质量启发式——模型更倾向把高质量文本判为自己写的。摘要未给出统一数值，但强调不同 setup 会导致先前文献得出相互冲突的结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs can recognize their own generated text, and how this can bias LLM-as-a-judge or monitoring setups.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation-method paper. Its value is not a new model, but the claim that conclusions about SGTR are highly sensitive to operationalization. If the protocol is not clean, judge/monitor systems may be biased by self-recognition or by quality heuristics, undermining evaluation and safety pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors systematically vary key design choices in SGTR experiments: pairwise versus individual assessment, conversation structure such as placing candidate text under user versus assistant tags, and the task domain used to generate candidate text, including coding and summarization. They evaluate 13-21 models across six operationalizations and analyze quality heuristics, cross-task transfer, and downstream bias.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans 13-21 models and six evaluation setups. The main finding is that SGTR accuracy changes substantially with evaluation format, prompt wrapping, and task domain. It also corroborates and clarifies the quality-heuristic effect, where models are more likely to attribute higher-quality text to themselves. The abstract does not provide a single headline number, but stresses that prior conflicting conclusions can be reconciled by protocol differences.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练本身关系不深，但做 judge/monitor 或自博弈评测的人该看；只读 operationalization 拆解和 quality heuristic 部分，别把任何单一 SGTR 数字当能力结论。
recommendation.en: Not central to pretraining, but worth a look if you build judges, monitors, or self-play evals; read the operationalization breakdown and quality-heuristic sections, and do not treat any single SGTR number as a capability fact.

paper.title: Piloting the world's first double-blind AI evaluations
paper.abstract: Piloting the world's first double-blind AI evaluations

summary.core_problem: 解决 AI 评测中评审者偏见、模型身份泄露和结果可比性不足的问题，尝试把“双盲评测”引入模型评估流程。
summary.importance: 这是评测协议层面的工作，不是新模型方法。它的重要性在于如果双盲流程设计得当，能减少品牌效应、提示泄露和主观打分偏差，对高噪声的人类偏好评测、模型对比和后训练反馈信号质量都有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: Google DeepMind 以博客形式介绍一套双盲 AI 评测试点：评测参与方和评审方尽量不暴露模型身份，重点在评测流程、匿名化、任务呈现和结果收集机制，而不是提出新的 judge 模型或 benchmark。本质上是 evaluation protocol 的改造。
summary.experiments: 公开信息不足，未见论文级别的系统实验细节。可确认的是这是一次 pilot，而非完整 benchmark 论文；没有给出可复现的模型规模、数据规模、显著性检验或与单盲/非盲评测的严格对照结果，因此更适合作为评测治理信号而非技术结论。
summary.authors_note: Google DeepMind。属于顶级实验室在评测流程治理上的公开表态，但不是正式研究论文。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets bias, model-identity leakage, and weak comparability in AI evaluation by piloting a double-blind evaluation protocol.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-protocol contribution rather than a modeling one. If done cleanly, double-blind evaluation can reduce brand effects, prompt leakage, and subjective judging bias, which matters for human preference evaluation and for the quality of post-training feedback signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Google DeepMind describes a pilot double-blind AI evaluation setup where model identities are hidden from evaluators and participants as much as possible. The contribution is in protocol design, anonymization, task presentation, and result collection, not in a new judge model or benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: Public details are limited. This appears to be a pilot rather than a full benchmark paper; there are no paper-level ablations, model scales, dataset sizes, or rigorous blind-vs-non-blind comparisons disclosed. Treat it as a governance/evaluation signal, not a settled technical result.
summary_en.authors_note: Google DeepMind. This is a top-lab statement on evaluation protocol design, but not a formal research paper.

recommendation.zh: 做偏好评测或 model ranking 的人可以知道这件事，但信息密度不高；先看它如何定义盲化边界，别把它当成已验证的方法学结论。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing if you run preference evals or model ranking, but the signal is thin; look only at how they define the blinding boundary, not as a validated methodology result.

paper.title: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks
paper.abstract: Most LLM benchmarks rank models on their ability to automate work tasks. In practice, however, models are often used to assist other (human or LLM) agents. The question that drives model selection is therefore not only which model produces the best output, but which model most improves the work of another (weaker) agent. We introduce a unified framework that evaluates the capability of models to automate and augment another agent's performance. Across seven economically grounded real-world tasks

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的问题不是提升模型能力，而是重新定义一类更贴近真实使用方式的评测：很多工作场景里，模型并不是直接完成任务，而是给人类或较弱模型提供帮助。现有 benchmark 大多只测 automation，也就是模型独立产出最终结果的能力，却很少测 augmentation，也就是模型能否让另一个执行者做得更好。论文提出 CentaurBench，用统一框架在同一组真实工作任务上同时评估这两种能力，并检验二者是否一致。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接作用有限，它更偏评测与部署选择。但它有一个值得注意的启发：模型的“自己做得好”与“教别人做得好”不是同一种能力，二者相关性并不高。对于 post-train、teacher model、self-improvement pipeline、decomposition/critique 数据合成，这个结论是有用的，因为很多训练流程默认强模型天然也是好教师。CentaurBench 给出一个更细的视角：指导文本是否适合下游执行者、是否可操作、是否不过载，可能比 assistant 自身上限更重要。若把弱 worker 换成固定 student policy，这个框架也可看作 teacher quality eval。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，论文构造了一个双模式评测协议。对每个任务和每个候选模型，automation 模式下模型直接完成任务；augmentation 模式下，候选模型只输出 assistance text，由一个固定的低能力 worker model 根据这段帮助文本去完成任务。这样做的关键是把 executor 固定住，从而把最终结果中的差异尽量归因到 assistant 的指导质量，而不是团队里谁更强。评测覆盖 7 类有经济含义的真实工作任务。输出质量通过多位 LLM judge 按任务定制 rubric 做 blind pairwise comparison，并且避免同家族模型评自己家输出。最终得到的是一个按任务和模式分解的 rank matrix，而不是单一总榜。这个设计的核心优点是可比性强：同一任务、同一 worker、同一 judge protocol 下，可以直接比较“直接做”和“辅助别人做”两种能力。局限也很明确：augmentation 的结论依赖所选 worker model，测到的是‘对这个 worker 的帮助能力’，不是对所有人类或所有模型的普适帮助能力。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三点。第一，augmentation 与 automation 的模型排名只中等相关，整体 rank correlation 约为 0.48，说明二者不能互相替代。第二，这个相关性在任务间波动很大，从 travel planning 的 -0.04 到 tax preparation 的 0.85，表明任务结构会显著影响“好执行者”和“好助手”是否重合。第三，帮助并不总是有益。论文提到 GPT-5-mini 在 automation 和 augmentation 两种模式下平均都排第一，但在 augmentation 比较里，不带任何外部帮助、由 GPT-3.5-Turbo 单独完成任务的 worker baseline 反而拿到第二名平均排名。这说明一些 assistant 生成的指导可能过于复杂、和 worker 能力不匹配，或者在任务上校准失当，结果不如不帮。任务级 reversal 也很明显，例如 Claude-Opus-4.8 在 market trends analysis 上是最强 automation 模型之一，平均 rank 2.05，但在同任务 augmentation 上接近最弱，8.15；而 GPT-4.1 在 counseling 上则呈现相反画像。对读者来说，最值得看的不是谁排第一，而是这些 reversal 暗示了什么样的帮助文本更适合弱执行者。
summary.reading_guide: 这是典型的评测论文，泛读即可。先看任务设计和双模式协议，确认 augmentation 是如何 operationalize 的；再看 judge 设计、盲评和排除自评的细节，判断结果可信度；最后看 task-level rank table 和相关性分析。预计 20 到 30 分钟足够。若只关心方法启发，重点看两处：一是固定 worker 的设计为什么能隔离 assistant 质量；二是哪些任务上 automation/augmentation 排名反转最大，这些任务通常更能暴露“会做”和“会教”的差异。若你做 pretrain，这篇不需要深读；若你做 teacher-student、self-play critique、AI delegation eval，可以把它当作一个有用的评测模板。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an evaluation gap rather than a new modeling method. Most LLM benchmarks measure automation: how well a model completes a task by itself. In real deployments, however, models are often used to assist another agent, human or model, rather than replace it. CentaurBench asks a different question: which model most improves the performance of a weaker worker? It builds a unified benchmark that measures both automation and augmentation on the same set of real-world work tasks.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it carries an important lesson for post-training and model-role design. A model that performs well as an autonomous solver is not necessarily a good teacher, coach, or critic for another agent. That matters for teacher-model selection, synthetic supervision pipelines, critique-based training, and delegation settings where a strong model is assumed to be a good guide by default. The benchmark makes that assumption testable. It also suggests that assistance quality depends on calibration to the downstream worker, not just raw model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark uses a two-mode protocol. In automation mode, the focal model completes the task end to end. In augmentation mode, the focal model produces assistance text only, and a fixed lower-capacity worker model uses that assistance to produce the final deliverable. Keeping the worker fixed is the key design choice: it isolates the marginal value of the assistant’s guidance from the executor’s own capability. The benchmark spans seven economically grounded professional tasks. Outputs are evaluated through blind pairwise comparisons by an LLM judge panel using task-specific rubrics, with family-level exclusions to avoid self-judging. The end product is a task-by-model rank matrix for both regimes rather than a single leaderboard. The main strength of the design is comparability across roles. The main limitation is external validity: augmentation performance is measured relative to one standardized worker, so it captures “helpfulness to this worker” rather than universal helpfulness.
summary_en.experiments: The headline findings are straightforward and useful. First, augmentation and automation rankings are only moderately correlated overall, with a model-level rank correlation of about 0.48. Second, the correlation varies sharply by task, from -0.04 on travel planning to 0.85 on tax preparation, showing that the overlap between being a strong solver and a strong assistant is task dependent. Third, assistance is not always beneficial. The paper reports that GPT-5-mini ranks first on average in both regimes, but in augmentation the unaided worker baseline, where GPT-3.5-Turbo works without any external help, achieves the second-best average rank. That means some assistance harms performance, likely because it is too complex, poorly calibrated, or mismatched to the worker. The task-level reversals are especially informative: for example, Claude-Opus-4.8 is among the strongest direct solvers on market trends analysis with mean rank 2.05, yet among the weakest assistants on the same task with 8.15, while GPT-4.1 shows the opposite profile on counseling.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the benchmark design and make sure the augmentation protocol is clear. Then read the judging setup carefully, especially the blind pairwise procedure and the anti-self-judging rule, because the credibility of the results depends on that. After that, go straight to the task-level rank tables and the automation-versus-augmentation correlation analysis. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough. The most useful questions to keep in mind are why fixing the worker isolates assistant quality, and which tasks produce the largest rank reversals. Those reversals are where the benchmark says something substantive about the difference between solving and helping.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain recipe，但会改你看 agent/eval 的口径：只看 automation 排名已经不够，读实验设计和相关性结果就够了。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your pretraining recipe, but it should change how you read agent evaluations: automation-only rankings are insufficient; focus on the protocol and the rank-correlation result.

paper.title: Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments
paper.abstract: Many areas of AI research, such as language model interpretability and chain of thought faithfulness, seek to explain model behaviors. But what constitutes a "good" explanation? In this work, we evaluate explanations through the lens of counterfactual simulatability-whether the explanation is useful for predicting model behaviors on related counterfactual inputs. To this end, we introduce CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits), a novel agentic pipeline that identifies unexpect

summary.core_problem: 如何评估 LLM 行为解释的质量？现有的可解释性研究往往缺乏在真实场景下、针对多样化模型行为的大规模评估方法，且难以验证解释是否真正揭示了行为的因果关系。
summary.importance: 本文提出通过“反事实可模拟性（counterfactual simulatability）”来评估解释，即解释是否有助于预测模型在相关反事实输入下的行为。这为 LLM 可解释性研究提供了一种新的、基于行为预测的评估范式，并构建了大规模的真实场景数据集。
summary.technical_approach: 引入 CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits) 自动化 Agent 流程：1. 采样：在大量真实 Prompt 上运行目标模型；2. 筛选：使用 Investigator 模型（如 Claude Opus）标记意外行为；3. 调查：Investigator Agent 进行 5-15 次反事实实验（修改 Prompt 并观察行为变化率）以隔离行为驱动因素；4. 验证：独立裁判评估实验对解释的支持程度。CHIVE 生成了数千个包含自然行为、开放式解释及支持性反事实实验的数据点。
summary.experiments: 应用 CHIVE 进行了两项研究：1. 评估可解释性工具：发现三种读取激活的工具（activation oracles, natural-language autoencoders, sparse autoencoders）在预测反事实实验结果时，均未能提升预测 Agent 的表现。2. 训练目标模型：使用 CHIVE 数据训练模型预测自身行为变化，发现模型在保留的调查任务和分布外 Prompt 源上表现出显著的泛化能力，优于未训练基线。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 2 关于 CHIVE 流程的设计，理解其如何自动化生成反事实实验数据。Section 3 中关于现有可解释性工具评估失败的结论非常反直觉，值得深思其原因。Section 4 展示了 CHIVE 数据在模型自我预测训练中的潜力。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate the quality of explanations for LLM behaviors? Existing interpretability research often lacks large-scale evaluation methods for diverse model behaviors in real-world scenarios and struggles to verify if explanations truly capture causal relationships.
summary_en.importance: This paper proposes evaluating explanations through the lens of "counterfactual simulatability"—whether an explanation helps predict model behavior on related counterfactual inputs. This introduces a novel, behavior-prediction-based evaluation paradigm for LLM interpretability and constructs a large-scale dataset of real-world scenarios.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits), an automated agentic pipeline: 1. Sample: Run the target model on numerous real-world prompts; 2. Screen: An investigator model (e.g., Claude Opus) flags unexpected behaviors; 3. Investigate: The investigator agent conducts 5-15 counterfactual experiments (editing prompts and observing behavior change rates) to isolate drivers; 4. Verify: An independent judge scores how well experiments support the explanation. CHIVE generates thousands of data points containing natural behaviors, open-ended explanations, and supporting counterfactual experiments.
summary_en.experiments: Applied CHIVE in two ways: 1. Evaluating interpretability tools: Found that three activation-reading tools (activation oracles, natural-language autoencoders, sparse autoencoders) provided no uplift to a predictor agent in forecasting counterfactual experiment results. 2. Training target models: Trained models using CHIVE data to predict their own behavior changes, demonstrating significant generalization on held-out investigations and out-of-distribution prompt sources, outperforming untrained baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the design of the CHIVE pipeline and how it automates counterfactual data generation. The counterintuitive finding in Section 3 regarding the failure of existing interpretability tools is worth deep reflection. Section 4 showcases the potential of CHIVE data in training models for self-prediction. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做interpretability或预训练机制分析的必须看§4的反常识结论，现有可解释性技术效用存疑，不要盲目用在基座分析中。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on interpretability or pretrain mechanism analysis must review the counterintuitive findings in §4; existing interpretability techniques have questionable utility, so do not blindly apply them to base model analysis.

paper.title: SCOPE: Score-Isolated Agentic Optimization for Video World Models
paper.abstract: Video world models are increasingly used as simulators for planning and embodied decision making, yet improving them at inference time introduces a subtle evaluation problem: prompts, samplers, verifiers, and selectors may evolve together, making it difficult to attribute gains or prevent held-out feedback from shaping the final policy. We introduce \scope (\emph{\scopefullname}), a framework for auditable inference-time adaptation of frozen video world models. \scope represents external control

summary.core_problem: 在推理阶段改进冻结的视频世界模型时，prompt、采样器、验证器和选择器共同演化，导致收益难以归因，并可能让保留集反馈泄漏到最终策略。
summary.importance: 提出可审计的推理时适配框架，重点是隔离评测信号和控制外部策略更新；对 test-time agent 与世界模型评测有一定方法提醒。
summary.technical_approach: SCOPE 将外部控制表示为有类型状态，只允许由开发集证据支持的有界变更，并在保留集评估前冻结策略；通过受控消融分离场景描述、采样和学习选择的贡献。
summary.experiments: 在 Physics-IQ 上比冻结基线提升 14.24，95% CI 为 [+8.10, +21.23]；跨主干和前瞻性评估显示鲁棒性，但相对最强匹配 agentic 基线的优势尚未确定。

summary_en.core_problem: When improving frozen video world models at inference time, prompts, samplers, verifiers, and selectors co-evolve, making gains hard to attribute and risking held-out feedback leakage.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an auditable inference-time adaptation framework that isolates evaluation signals and controls external policy updates; relevant as a caution for test-time agent and world-model evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SCOPE represents external controls as typed state, allows only bounded updates supported by development evidence, and freezes the policy before held-out evaluation. Controlled ablations separate gains from scene specification, sampling, and learned selection.
summary_en.experiments: On Physics-IQ, it improves over the frozen base by +14.24 with 95% CI [+8.10, +21.23]. Cross-backbone and prospective evaluations are reported, but the margin over the strongest matched agentic baseline remains unresolved.

recommendation.zh: 评测隔离的思路对 test-time agent 研究有提醒，但视频世界模型设定偏窄；看消融和 CI 即可，别把 +14 当泛化结论。
recommendation.en: The evaluation-isolation idea is useful for test-time agents, but the video-world-model setting is narrow. Read the ablations and CIs; do not overgeneralize the +14 gain.

paper.title: The Next Challenge for Agentic Cybersecurity: A Realistic, Contamination-Free Reverse Engineering Benchmark
paper.abstract: AI agents are rapidly improving in cybersecurity capabilities when the source code is available for analysis, yet much of the software most consequential to cybersecurity, including malware, firmware, and proprietary applications, is available only as binaries. Analyzing such software requires reverse engineering(RE): recovering program semantics before the analysis can be meaningfully performed. However, evaluating agentic RE poses a fundamental challenge: benchmark instances must be unseen as

summary.core_problem: 现有AI智能体的网络安全能力评测多基于源代码，但真实高价值目标（恶意软件、固件、专有软件）仅以二进制形式存在，需逆向工程（RE）能力支撑分析；现有RE基准无法同时满足两项核心要求：要么存在预训练数据污染（目标源码出现在训练语料中，模型靠识别而非真实分析得分，且RE场景下粗粒度污染的危害远高于其他安全任务的细粒度泄漏），要么采用CTF或玩具级程序，规模和反分析保护强度与真实软件不匹配，无法反映真实能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的具体启发包括两点：一是明确了预训练数据的粗粒度语义污染对专业能力评测的严重干扰，为预训练数据的去重、污染检测提出了更细分的专业场景要求；二是提供了一个无记忆捷径、难度匹配真实场景的专业能力基准，可用于验证LLM/Agent预训练后在低层级语义理解、抗混淆推理上的真实能力，而非依赖语料记忆的虚假性能。
summary.technical_approach: 投入5000+领域专家小时采用净室流程构建SRE-Bench：一是自研19个平均代码量16915.8行的私有程序，覆盖网络协议、固件、游戏、格式解析器、恶意软件5类真实RE高频场景；二是实现包含44种先进反分析原语的防护套件（总代码量27K+行，超半数原语无公开实现）。将私有程序与自研防护配置组合，生成262个无污染测试实例，每个实例配6项可确定性验证的任务，共1572个RE评测任务。
summary.experiments: 投入3.14万美元评测5个前沿模型，实验结果显示：性能最高的GPT-5.6-sol总体准确率仅61.4%，仅能完全恢复31.5%的实例；性能最低的模型无法完全恢复任何实例。自研反分析防护是核心瓶颈：使GPT-5.6-sol性能减半，其余模型性能降至接近0，原本的模型能力排名被拉平到近乎一致失效。模型失效模式与人类分析师存在显著差异：人类逆向的传统障碍（编译优化、链接处理）对模型影响极小，而符号剥离会带来显著性能损失，说明当前模型过度依赖词汇锚点而非深层语义理解。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先阅读第1章引言中关于RE场景污染特殊性的分析，再阅读第3章基准构建的净室流程与反分析套件设计，最后阅读第4章的模型评测结果与失效模式对比。预计阅读时间25-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing cybersecurity agent evaluations rely on source code, but real high-stakes targets including malware, firmware and proprietary software are only available as binaries that require reverse engineering (RE) for analysis. Current RE benchmarks fail to meet two critical requirements simultaneously: they either suffer from pretraining data contamination (target source code appears in training corpora, letting models score via recognition instead of actual analysis, and coarse-grained contamination in RE is far more harmful than fine-grained leakage in other security tasks), or use CTF-style or toy programs that lack the scale and anti-analysis protection intensity of real-world software.
summary_en.importance: This work brings two concrete implications for pretraining research. First, it quantifies the severe distortion of coarse-grained semantic contamination in pretraining data on specialized capability evaluation, raising more granular scenario-specific requirements for pretraining data deduplication and contamination detection. Second, it provides a shortcut-free, realistically difficult benchmark that can measure true low-level semantic reasoning and anti-obfuscation capability of LLMs/agents, instead of spurious performance from corpus memorization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The team invested 5,000+ domain expert hours to build SRE-Bench via a clean-room pipeline. It includes 19 in-house private programs with an average of 16,915.8 lines of code, covering 5 high-frequency real RE domains: network protocols, firmware, games, format parsers, and malware. A comprehensive anti-analysis suite with 44 advanced protection primitives (27K+ LoC in total, over half of which have no public implementations) is also developed. Combining private programs and custom protection configurations yields 262 contamination-free instances, each attached with 6 deterministically verifiable tasks for a total of 1,572 RE evaluation tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Five frontier models were evaluated at a total cost of $31.4K. The highest-performing model GPT-5.6-sol reaches only 61.4% overall accuracy and fully recovers just 31.5% of instances, while the lowest-performing model cannot fully recover any instance. Custom anti-analysis protections are the core bottleneck: they halve GPT-5.6-sol's performance and drive all other models to near-zero, collapsing the original capability ranking into near-uniform failure. Model failure modes differ significantly from human analysts: classical obstacles for manual RE (compilation optimization, linking processing) have minimal impact on models, while symbol stripping incurs heavy performance losses, indicating current agents over-rely on lexical anchors instead of deep semantic understanding.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: First read Section 1 for the analysis of contamination uniqueness in RE scenarios, then Section 3 for the clean-room benchmark construction pipeline and anti-analysis suite design, and finally Section 4 for model evaluation results and failure mode comparison. Estimated reading time: 25-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 无污染Agent基准的构建方法有参考价值，重点看§3数据构建与污染检测流程，可迁移到预训练数据去重验证。
recommendation.en: Contamination-free benchmark construction methodology is transferable; focus on §3 data building and contamination detection protocols, applicable to pretraining deduplication verification.

paper.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Measuring Cross-Lingual Policy Retention in Tool-Using Agents
paper.abstract: When a tool-using agent is given the same task in a different language, does it still take the same steps? Multilingual evaluation rarely asks: it compares final answers and discards the actions. Yet those actions are the product: they fix cost and latency, decide how the system fails, and are the only auditable part of its behaviour. We make the action policy the measured object across 8 models, 6 parallel benchmarks and 41 languages (2.38M rollouts). The naive measurement fails: five confounds

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个此前几乎没被正面测量的问题：多语言 tool-using agent 在语义等价任务上，跨语言后是否还保留同一套行动策略，而不是只看最终答案是否一致。对 agent 来说，真正决定成本、时延、失败模式和可审计性的，是中间 action trace，不是最后一句答案。难点不在收集轨迹，而在如何把“跨语言策略差异”从长度偏置、空轨迹、随机重合、解码噪声和模型自身不稳定性里分离出来，得到可解释的 retention 指标。
summary.importance: 虽然它不属于狭义 pretrain 论文，但对基座研究有两层价值。第一，它把 multilingual 能力从 answer parity 推进到 policy retention，这更接近真实部署中的行为一致性，也更能反推预训练与 post-train 是否学到了语言无关的工具使用策略。第二，作者发现多个差异很大的模型在 greedy 条件下都收敛到接近的 retention 水平，大约只保留 71–73% 的原有行动策略；这说明跨语言迁移里存在稳定的 policy loss，而不是个别模型的偶然缺陷。对预训练研究者来说，这会直接引出两个问题：训练语料中的英语中心性是否塑造了 agent policy；以及 instruction tuning / tool-use SFT 是否把非英语请求隐式路由成英语中间表示。
summary.technical_approach:
技术核心是一个校正后的跨语言 action-policy 测量协议。作者在固定 scaffold 下，让模型在共享的五工具字母表中执行任务，并显式输出已执行的 action trace。数据覆盖 8 个模型、6 个平行 benchmark、41 种语言，总计 2.38M rollouts。若直接比较不同语言的 trace 相似度，会被五类混杂因素污染：短轨迹天然更容易相似；空轨迹会虚高；无关轨迹也可能有较高 chance overlap；模型在同语言重复运行时本就不完全一致；没有 same-language baseline 时，跨语言差异不可识别。

作者的修正办法有几个关键点。第一，每个语言-任务单元都在相同解码设置下跑两次，只改变 serving seed。第二，定义 same-language agreement I_within：同一语言两次运行的轨迹一致性；定义 cross-language agreement I_cross：不同语言、不同 seed 的轨迹一致性。第三，用归一化保留率 \tilde{I}=I_cross/I_within，把跨语言一致性除以模型自身可复现性上限，得到“语言变化后保留了多少原有策略”。第四，所有比较都做双向 length matching，并丢弃任一侧为空轨迹的样本，避免长度和空轨迹伪信号。第五，用 task-level bootstrap 给区间估计。

在机制分析上，作者进一步测试为什么会丢 policy retention。证据指向英语 pivot：Translate 是最常用工具，且即便输入是天城文等非拉丁脚本，模型的 reasoning text 也约 99% 为 ASCII。去掉 translation tool 会按模型原本对翻译工具的依赖程度降低 length-matched agreement；强制使用 translation tool 则按预注册顺序帮助不同模型。也就是说，很多模型不是直接在目标语言上执行同一策略，而是先把问题映射到英语工作流，再在英语中完成规划与工具调用。
summary.experiments:
实验规模很大：8 个模型、6 个平行 benchmark、41 种语言、2.38M agent rollouts。核心结果有三组。第一，在 greedy decoding 下，全部 24 个主要 cell 都出现正的跨语言 policy gap，且 raw gap 的 bootstrap 区间都排除了 0，说明差异稳定存在。第二，做完全部校正后，效应不是变小而是变大；这很关键，因为它说明过去看不见问题，不是因为问题弱，而是因为测量方法把它淹没了。第三，在四个差异很大的模型上，归一化 policy retention 在 greedy 条件下高度接近，约 71–73%；并且这种规律不只体现在模型均值上，而是体现在 24 个 cell 的分布上，模型身份只能解释约 5.7% 的方差。

温度实验也很有信息量。作者做了五档 temperature ladder，发现随着采样温度升高，cross-language agreement 变化不大，但 same-language self-consistency 明显下降，因此如果只看未经归一化的相似度，采样噪声会掩盖真实的跨语言 policy loss。机制实验方面，Translate 工具在所有适配 benchmark 中都是最高频工具；reasoning 文本几乎全是 ASCII，说明非英语任务常被转写到英语内部通道。移除翻译工具会按模型原有翻译使用率成比例地降低 agreement；强制翻译则按预注册预测顺序改善结果。若精读全文，建议重点核对各 benchmark 的工具定义是否足够统一、length matching 的具体算法、以及不同语言族上的 retention 是否存在系统性偏差。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇值得精读。先看 Introduction 和方法部分，弄清作者为什么坚持把 action trace 而不是 final answer 作为被测对象，以及五个 confound 分别如何扭曲结论。随后重点看定义 I_within、I_cross 和 \tilde{I} 的章节，这里是全文最重要的识别设计。再看 Figure 2 一类主结果图，确认“所有校正都会让效应更大”这一点。之后读温度实验和 translation-tool 机制分析，这两部分解释了为什么多语言 agent 看起来能答对，但内部 policy 仍然不一致。

如果要带着预训练视角去读，建议特别关注两点。第一，英语 pivot 现象是否来自预训练语料分布、tokenizer、还是 post-train 工具使用数据的英语中心性。第二，71–73% 这种近似常数是否暗示了某种跨语言 policy bottleneck，类似于“语言变了，但内部 planner 只保留部分可迁移结构”。预计完整读一遍正文加关键附录需要 45–60 分钟。附录里关于 estimator、confound cost 和 design checks 的部分不要跳过，否则很容易低估这个测量问题的难度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper measures something multilingual evaluation has mostly ignored: whether a tool-using agent preserves the same action policy when the task is expressed in another language. Final-answer parity is not enough for agents, because the route determines cost, latency, failure mode, and what can actually be audited or governed. The hard part is not collecting traces but identifying a clean cross-lingual policy signal despite length bias, empty traces, chance overlap, decoding noise, and the model’s own within-language instability.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for foundation-model research in two ways. First, it upgrades multilingual evaluation from answer equivalence to policy retention, which is much closer to real deployment behavior and more informative about whether the model has learned language-invariant tool-use structure. Second, the paper finds a striking regularity: under greedy decoding, several very different models retain only about 71–73% of their own action policy after a language change. That suggests a stable cross-lingual policy loss rather than an idiosyncratic failure of one model. For pretraining researchers, this raises direct questions about English-centric data mixtures, internal pivot languages, and whether tool-use post-training teaches non-English requests to route through English latent workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core contribution is a corrected protocol for measuring cross-lingual action-policy retention. Under a fixed scaffold, models operate over a shared five-tool alphabet and emit executed action traces alongside answers. The study covers 8 models, 6 parallel benchmarks, 41 languages, and 2.38 million rollouts. A naive trace-similarity metric fails for five reasons: short traces look artificially similar, empty traces score perfectly, unrelated traces overlap by chance, same-language reruns are not identical, and without a within-language baseline the quantity is not identifiable.

The estimator addresses each issue explicitly. Every language-task cell is run twice with identical decoding settings and token budgets, changing only the serving seed. Same-language agreement, I_within, compares the two replicates in one language. Cross-language agreement, I_cross, compares traces across languages, also cross-seed. The normalized retention metric is \tilde{I}=I_cross/I_within, which measures how much of a model’s own reproducible policy survives a language change. Comparisons are length-matched in both directions, pairs are dropped if either trace is empty, and uncertainty is estimated with task-level bootstraps. This design makes language the only systematic difference while keeping decoding noise symmetric.

The paper then probes mechanism. The evidence points to an English pivot. Translate is the most frequently used tool across adapted benchmarks, and reasoning text is about 99% ASCII even for non-Latin inputs such as Devanagari. Removing the translation tool lowers agreement in proportion to a model’s prior reliance on translation; forcing translation helps in a pre-registered ordering across models. The implication is that many multilingual agents do not execute the same policy directly in the target language. They often map the task into an English-centered internal workflow and plan from there.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical scale is substantial: 8 models, 6 parallel benchmarks, 41 languages, and 2.38M rollouts. Three results stand out. First, under greedy decoding, all 24 main cells show a positive cross-lingual policy gap, and every bootstrap interval on the raw gap excludes zero. The effect is stable rather than anecdotal. Second, every correction increases the measured effect instead of shrinking it. That is important because it means the problem was previously hidden by bad measurement, not because it was weak. Third, after normalization, four otherwise very different models converge to nearly the same policy-retention value under greedy decoding: about 71–73%. The regularity holds at the cell level, not just in model averages, and model identity explains only about 5.7% of the variance.

The temperature ladder is also informative. As sampling temperature rises, cross-language agreement changes little, while same-language self-consistency drops sharply. Without normalization, sampling noise masks the true cross-lingual policy loss. On the mechanism side, Translate is the most-used tool in every adapted benchmark, and reasoning text is almost entirely ASCII, indicating that non-English tasks are often routed through an English internal channel. Removing translation hurts agreement roughly in proportion to how much a model already uses it; forcing translation helps in the pre-registered order predicted from those usage rates. When reading the full paper, it is worth checking how tightly the tool alphabet is standardized across benchmarks, how the bidirectional length matching is implemented, and whether retention differs systematically across language families.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction and method sections to understand why the paper insists on measuring action traces rather than final answers, and how each of the five confounds can distort the conclusion. Then read the section defining I_within, I_cross, and \tilde{I}; that is the identification core of the paper. After that, inspect the main result figures, especially the claim that every correction makes the effect larger. Finally, read the temperature analysis and the translation-tool ablations, which explain why multilingual agents can look answer-consistent while still following different internal policies.

From a pretraining angle, two questions are especially worth carrying through the paper. First, is the English-pivot behavior driven mainly by pretraining data distribution, tokenizer effects, or English-heavy tool-use post-training data? Second, does the near-constant 71–73% retention hint at a structural bottleneck in cross-lingual policy transfer, where only part of the planner survives language change? A full read of the main text plus the key appendices will likely take 45–60 minutes. The appendix sections on the estimator, confound costs, and design checks are essential; skipping them makes the result look simpler than it is.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改你做 multilingual agent eval 的 protocol；先看五个 confound 的拆解，再看 greedy 下仍不保策略这一条，值得内部 benchmark 立刻照抄。
recommendation.en: This should change how you run multilingual agent evals; read the five confounds first, then the result that policy divergence survives greedy decoding, and copy the protocol into your internal benchmark.

paper.title: The Illusion of Visual Tool-Use: A Causal Audit of Thinking with Images
paper.abstract: The "thinking-with-images" paradigm equips multimodal LLMs with active visual operations such as crop-and-zoom. However, models using these operations often achieve only marginal or negative gains over direct inference at substantially higher token cost.
